::: {.hero-bio}
<p class="type-reveal" data-type-speed="24">I am a PhD student in Psychology at Harvard University. I work primarily with Jason P. Mitchell and Mahzarin R. Banaji.</p>
:::

::: {.hero-bio}
<p class="type-reveal" data-type-speed="24">My research program is bi-directional. On one end, I combine behavioral experiments to uncover what processes people use when judging the humanness or AI-ness of text, how they update their beliefs, and what cues they focus on in digital environments. On the other, I examine what aspects of human cognition have seeped into the weights of LLMs, and where these models align (or diverge) from human behavior.</p>
:::

::: {.hero-bio}
<p class="type-reveal" data-type-speed="24">I also love stand-up comedy, building tools for various applications, making instrumental music, and the manga One Piece :)</p>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const initMotion = () => {
    const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

    const revealLines = document.querySelectorAll(".type-reveal");
    const animateTypedLine = (el, done) => {
      const fullText = el.dataset.fullText || el.textContent.trim();
      const baseSpeed = Number(el.dataset.typeSpeed || 14);

      el.dataset.fullText = fullText;
      el.textContent = "";

      let i = 0;
      el.classList.add("typewriter-active");

      const tick = () => {
        if (i >= fullText.length) {
          el.classList.remove("typewriter-active");
          el.classList.add("typewriter-done");
          done();
          return;
        }

        i += 1;
        el.textContent = fullText.slice(0, i);
        const ch = fullText[i - 1];
        const extraPause = /[.,;:!?]/.test(ch) ? baseSpeed * 4 : 0;
        window.setTimeout(tick, baseSpeed + extraPause);
      };

      tick();
    };

    const nameHeading = document.querySelector(".name-row h2");
    if (nameHeading && !nameHeading.dataset.maskInit) {
      const rawName = nameHeading.textContent.trim();
      nameHeading.dataset.maskInit = "true";
      nameHeading.textContent = "";

      for (const ch of rawName) {
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.className = ch === " " ? "name-gap" : "name-char";
        span.textContent = ch;
        nameHeading.appendChild(span);
      }
    }

    const nameChars = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".name-row .name-char"));
    let nameMaskStarted = false;
    const startNameMaskEffect = () => {
      if (nameMaskStarted || prefersReducedMotion || nameChars.length === 0) return;
      nameMaskStarted = true;

      const triggerMaskPulse = () => {
        const pulseSize = Math.random() < 0.72 ? 1 : 2;
        const picked = new Set();

        while (picked.size < pulseSize) {
          picked.add(Math.floor(Math.random() * nameChars.length));
        }

        picked.forEach((idx) => {
          const charEl = nameChars[idx];
          if (!charEl) return;
          charEl.classList.add("is-masked");
          const revealAfter = 130 + Math.random() * 290;
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            charEl.classList.remove("is-masked");
          }, revealAfter);
        });

        const nextPulse = 860 + Math.random() * 1960;
        window.setTimeout(triggerMaskPulse, nextPulse);
      };

      const initialDelay = 1200 + Math.random() * 1200;
      window.setTimeout(triggerMaskPulse, initialDelay);
    };

    if (revealLines.length > 0) {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) {
        revealLines.forEach((line) => {
          const fullText = line.dataset.fullText || line.textContent.trim();
          line.dataset.fullText = fullText;
          line.textContent = fullText;
          line.classList.remove("typewriter-active");
          line.classList.add("typewriter-done");
        });
        startNameMaskEffect();
      } else {
        revealLines.forEach((line) => {
          const fullText = line.dataset.fullText || line.textContent.trim();
          line.dataset.fullText = fullText;
          line.textContent = "";
        });

        let idx = 0;
        const runNext = () => {
          if (idx >= revealLines.length) {
            startNameMaskEffect();
            return;
          }
          animateTypedLine(revealLines[idx], () => {
            idx += 1;
            window.setTimeout(runNext, 220);
          });
        };
        window.setTimeout(runNext, 420);
      }
    } else {
      startNameMaskEffect();
    }

    const brainOrb = document.querySelector(".brain-orb");
    if (!brainOrb || prefersReducedMotion) {
      return;
    }

    const maxTilt = 6;

    brainOrb.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      const rect = brainOrb.getBoundingClientRect();
      const px = (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width;
      const py = (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
      const tiltY = (px - 0.5) * (maxTilt * 2);
      const tiltX = (0.5 - py) * (maxTilt * 2);

      brainOrb.style.setProperty("--brain-tilt-x", `${tiltX.toFixed(2)}deg`);
      brainOrb.style.setProperty("--brain-tilt-y", `${tiltY.toFixed(2)}deg`);
    });

    brainOrb.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => {
      brainOrb.style.setProperty("--brain-tilt-x", "0deg");
      brainOrb.style.setProperty("--brain-tilt-y", "0deg");
    });
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initMotion, { once: true });
  } else {
    initMotion();
  }
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Sand effect: moving the mouse through the name scatters the letters under it
// into grains, which drift back and fill the letters in again.
(() => {
  const init = () => {
    if (window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches) return;
    const row = document.querySelector(".name-row");
    const name = row && row.querySelector("h2");
    if (!name) return;

    const PAD = 70;    // room around the name for grains to fly
    const R = 26;      // brush radius (px)
    const OUT = 380;   // ms grains fly outward
    const BACK = 1150; // ms until grains are home and the letters are whole again
    const MAX_HOLES = 24;

    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.className = "sand-canvas";
    canvas.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    row.appendChild(canvas);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const glyph = document.createElement("canvas");
    const gctx = glyph.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });

    let dpr = 1, w = 0, h = 0, ink = null, sampledAt = 0;
    let grains = [], holes = [], lastPt = null, running = false, lastFrame = 0;
    const ease = (t) => (t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2);

    const layout = () => {
      dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
      w = name.offsetWidth;
      h = name.offsetHeight;
      canvas.style.left = name.offsetLeft - PAD + "px";
      canvas.style.top = name.offsetTop - PAD + "px";
      canvas.style.width = w + PAD * 2 + "px";
      canvas.style.height = h + PAD * 2 + "px";
      canvas.width = Math.round((w + PAD * 2) * dpr);
      canvas.height = Math.round((h + PAD * 2) * dpr);
    };

    // Draw the letters as they look right now, so grains only come from ink
    const sample = () => {
      const cs = getComputedStyle(name);
      const fvs = cs.fontVariationSettings;
      const axis = (tag, dflt) => {
        const m = fvs.match(new RegExp('"' + tag + '"\\s+(-?[\\d.]+)'));
        return m ? parseFloat(m[1]) : dflt;
      };
      const wght = Math.round(axis("wght", 500));
      const skew = Math.tan((axis("slnt", 0) * Math.PI) / 180);
      glyph.width = w;
      glyph.height = h;
      gctx.font = `${wght} ${parseFloat(cs.fontSize)}px Recursive, sans-serif`;
      gctx.fillStyle = "#000";
      const box = name.getBoundingClientRect();
      for (const span of name.querySelectorAll(".name-char")) {
        if (span.classList.contains("is-masked")) continue;
        const r = span.getBoundingClientRect();
        const m = gctx.measureText(span.textContent);
        const asc = m.fontBoundingBoxAscent;
        const desc = m.fontBoundingBoxDescent;
        const baseline = r.top - box.top + (r.height - (asc + desc)) / 2 + asc;
        gctx.save();
        gctx.translate(r.left - box.left, baseline);
        gctx.transform(1, 0, skew, 1, 0, 0);
        gctx.fillText(span.textContent, 0, 0);
        gctx.restore();
      }
      ink = gctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
      sampledAt = performance.now();
    };

    const inkAt = (x, y) => {
      x = Math.round(x);
      y = Math.round(y);
      if (!ink || x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= w || y >= h) return false;
      return ink[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3] > 128;
    };

    const brush = (x, y, vx, vy) => {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - sampledAt > 150) sample();
      holes.push({ x, y, t: now });
      if (holes.length > MAX_HOLES) holes.shift();
      let made = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < 90 && made < 26; i++) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const d = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * R * 0.85;
        const hx = x + Math.cos(a) * d;
        const hy = y + Math.sin(a) * d;
        if (!inkAt(hx, hy)) continue;
        const len = Math.hypot(hx - x, hy - y) || 1;
        const kick = 2.2 + Math.random() * 3.2;
        grains.push({
          hx, hy, x: hx, y: hy, t: now,
          vx: ((hx - x) / len) * kick + vx * 0.25 + (Math.random() - 0.5),
          vy: ((hy - y) / len) * kick + vy * 0.25 + (Math.random() - 0.5) - 0.6,
          s: Math.random() < 0.3 ? 2 : 1.4,
        });
        made++;
      }
      if (grains.length > 1400) grains.splice(0, grains.length - 1400);
      if (!running) {
        running = true;
        lastFrame = performance.now();
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
    };

    const applyMask = (now) => {
      holes = holes.filter((hl) => now - hl.t < BACK);
      if (!holes.length) {
        name.style.webkitMaskImage = "";
        name.style.maskImage = "";
        return;
      }
      const layers = holes
        .map((hl) => {
          const age = now - hl.t;
          const r = Math.max(age < OUT ? R : R * (1 - ease((age - OUT) / (BACK - OUT))), 0.1);
          return `radial-gradient(circle ${r.toFixed(1)}px at ${hl.x.toFixed(1)}px ${hl.y.toFixed(1)}px, transparent ${(r * 0.8).toFixed(1)}px, #000 ${r.toFixed(1)}px)`;
        })
        .join(", ");
      name.style.webkitMaskImage = layers;
      name.style.webkitMaskComposite = "source-in";
      name.style.maskImage = layers;
      name.style.maskComposite = "intersect";
    };

    const tick = (now) => {
      const dt = Math.min(Math.max((now - lastFrame) / 16.67, 0), 3); // frame-rate independent
      lastFrame = now;
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(name).color;
      grains = grains.filter((g) => now - g.t < BACK);
      for (const g of grains) {
        const age = now - g.t;
        if (age < OUT) {
          const f = Math.pow(0.9, dt);
          g.vx *= f;
          g.vy = g.vy * f + 0.12 * dt;
          g.x += g.vx * dt;
          g.y += g.vy * dt;
        } else {
          if (g.ox === undefined) {
            g.ox = g.x;
            g.oy = g.y;
          }
          const p = ease(Math.min((age - OUT) / (BACK - OUT), 1));
          g.x = g.ox + (g.hx - g.ox) * p;
          g.y = g.oy + (g.hy - g.oy) * p;
        }
        ctx.fillRect(g.x + PAD - g.s / 2, g.y + PAD - g.s / 2, g.s, g.s);
      }
      applyMask(now);
      if (grains.length || holes.length) {
        requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        running = false;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener(
      "pointermove",
      (e) => {
        const box = name.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - box.left;
        const y = e.clientY - box.top;
        if (x < -R || y < -R || x > box.width + R || y > box.height + R) {
          lastPt = null;
          return;
        }
        if (!w) layout();
        const vx = lastPt ? x - lastPt.x : 0;
        const vy = lastPt ? y - lastPt.y : 0;
        if (lastPt && Math.hypot(vx, vy) < 4) return;
        lastPt = { x, y };
        brush(x, y, vx, vy);
      },
      { passive: true }
    );
    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      layout();
      sampledAt = 0;
    });
    if (document.fonts) document.fonts.ready.then(layout);
    layout();
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init, { once: true });
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
